raw_text: The button that pushes the hair off stopped working after two months. Now cleaning it is a pain.

Pins are too sharp, my cat runs away as soon as she sees it.
Removes a ton of undercoat but hair gets stuck between the teeth and I have to pick it out by hand.
Too big for my small cat, can't reach under the legs.
Best deshedding tool I've owned. Pricey but worth it.
My cat loves the glove, it feels like petting. Doesn't remove much undercoat though.
